Bounded scoped Hilog collection, device selection and truncation metadata. Continuous capture has separate gap and quota reporting.
Fetch an explicit validated faultlog filename after inventory selection; retain original bytes and selection/truncation status.
Combine scoped logs, attributed crash parsing, knowledge cases and next observations; hypotheses and repairs belong to host reasoning.
Parse attributed crash kind/message/stack and rank user frames; preserve uncertain signatures and source-map limits.
Inventory faultlogs with device/app/time scope and distinguish empty inventory, unsupported listing and incomplete evidence.
Resolve the configured SDK HDC tool and explicit target; typed native invocation replaces upstream script shell execution.
Faultlog inventory, app identity matching and bounded original-file reads are implemented by the native log service.
Structured crash extraction and frame attribution with explicit insufficient-evidence outcomes, rather than treating any log mention as a crash.
Bounded structured errors/artifacts replace console formatting and script helpers; generic formatting does not create a separate runtime tool.
Chinese original preserves the same debug method; the locale variant is not an independent lifecycle.

agents.definition:
{
            name: "build",
            description: "The default agent. Executes tools based on configured permissions.",
            options: {},
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                question: "allow",
                plan_enter: "ask",
                plan_write: "deny",
                verify_ui: "ask",
                save_ui_screenshot: "ask",
                get_ui_verification_log: "ask",
              }),
              user,
            ),
            mode: "primary",
            native: true,
            prompt: PROMPT_BUILD,
          }

{
            name: "debug",
            description: "Sticky ArkTS debugging mode triggered by /debug",
            options: {},
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                question: "allow",
                todowrite: "allow",
                build_project: "allow",
                start_app: "allow",
                hdc_log: "allow",
                debug_exit: "allow",
              }),
              user,
            ),
            mode: "primary",
            native: true,
            hidden: true,
            prompt: PROMPT_DEBUG,
          }

{
            name: "explore",
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                "*": "deny",
                grep: "allow",
                glob: "allow",
                list: "allow",
                bash: "allow",
                webfetch: "allow",
                websearch: "allow",
                read: "allow",
                external_directory: readonlyExternalDirectory,
              }),
              user,
            ),
            description: `Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions.`,
            prompt: PROMPT_EXPLORE,
            options: {},
            mode: "subagent",
            native: true,
          }

{
            name: "goal",
            description: "Multi-turn goal-driven agent with verifiable termination",
            options: {},
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                question: "allow",
                plan_enter: "allow",
                webfetch: "allow",
                websearch: "allow",
                todowrite: "allow",
                spec_write: "allow",
                task: "allow",
              }),
              user,
            ),
            mode: "primary",
            native: true,
            prompt: PROMPT_GOAL,
            color: "info",
          }

{
            name: "spec-implementation",
            description: "Execute implementation tasks from an approved spec",
            options: {},
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                question: "allow",
                build_project: "deny",
                start_app: "deny",
              }),
              user,
            ),
            mode: "subagent",
            native: true,
            hidden: true,
            prompt: PROMPT_SPEC_IMPLEMENTATION,
          }

{
            name: "spec-verify",
            description: "Build, deploy, and UI-verify Harmony features against spec",
            options: {},
            permission: Permission.merge(
              defaults,
              Permission.fromConfig({
                question: "allow",
                verify_ui: "allow",
                save_ui_screenshot: "allow",
                get_ui_verification_log: "allow",
              }),
              user,
            ),
            mode: "subagent",
            native: true,
            hidden: true,
            temperature: 0.2,
            prompt: PROMPT_SPEC_VERIFY,
          }
